We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is implicit? Maybe we need to retrieve NMR spectra and infer number of methyl groups from peaks? Could be a known molecule from previous tasks. No context. We could ask for proton NMR to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (requires SMILES). But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the system expects we use carbon_nmr_spectra to count methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). But again need sample.

Maybe the molecule is the one "at hand" - the environment has a sample. The tools carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra operate on "sample at hand" without parameters. So we can just call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count methyl carbon signals (around 10-30 ppm). Let's do that.
